description.value: At 2nd level, you have learned how to create basic barriers to protect areas or trap opponents and protect allies. As an action for up to your Cursed Energy modifier in cursed energy, you make a dome starting from yourself with a 5-foot radius and a 10-foot height. For each cursed energy spent, the barrier can increase its width by 10 feet and its height by 10 feet. This barrier has 10 hit points per cursed energy spent and is immune to Poison and Psychic damage. This barrier lasts a number of minutes equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. At 9th level, your barriers have health equal to 20 times the cursed energy spent, and at 15th level it is resistant to damage from the outside.
